question.problem:
The marginal CDFs of two continuous independent random variables $X$ and $Y$ are given below. 

$$
{F}_{X}(x)=\{\begin{aligned}1-\frac{16}{{x}^{4}}, & x\ge 2 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\,\,{F}_{Y}(y)=\{\begin{aligned}1-\frac{8}{{y}^{3}}, & y\ge 2 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Find the expression for the joint CDF when $x\ge 2$ and $y\ge 2.$
question.worked_solution:
If $X$ and $Y$ are independent continuous random variables with marginal CDFs ${F}_{X}(x)$ and ${F}_{Y}(y),$ respectively, then the corresponding joint CDF of $F(x,y)$ is given by

$$
F(x,y)={F}_{X}(x)\cdot {F}_{Y}(y).
$$

Therefore, for $x\ge 2$ and $y\ge 2,$ the joint CDF for our random variables is 

$$
\begin{aligned}F(x,y) & ={F}_{X}(x)\cdot {F}_{Y}(y) \\  & =(1-\frac{16}{{x}^{4}})(1-\frac{8}{{y}^{3}}) \\  & =1-\frac{16}{{x}^{4}}-\frac{8}{{y}^{3}}+\frac{128}{{x}^{4}{y}^{3}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the full expression for the joint CDF is

$$
F(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}1-\frac{16}{{x}^{4}}-\frac{8}{{y}^{3}}+\frac{128}{{x}^{4}{y}^{3}}, & x\ge 2,\,y\ge 2 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$
